question: What is the validity period and fee schedule for a Ground Preparation and Excavation Permit (GP&EP)?
answer:
The validity period for a Ground Preparation and Excavation Permit (GP&EP) is not explicitly stated in the provided sources. However, the fees for a GP&EP are as follows:

- Per cubic meter of excavation for renewal: Php 4.00 [S3]
- Per square meter of structure: Php 38.00 [S3]
- For the first 10-meter height: Php 2,400.00 [S1, S3]
- For every meter or fraction thereof in excess of 10.00 meters: Php 120.00 per meter [S1]
- Additional accessory fees may apply [S1, S2]

For more detailed information about the validity period, please refer to the National Building Code of the Philippines (PD 1096) and its Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations.

ground_truth: While the Building Permit is being processed, the Building Official may issue GP&EP for foundation subject to line-and-grade verification, inspection and review. It is valid only for 30 days or superseded upon Building Permit issuance. Fees: inspection/verification PHP200; excavation PHP3 per cubic meter; GP&EP issuance PHP50; foundation excavation with basement PHP4 per cubic meter; excavation other than foundation/basement PHP3 per cubic meter; permitted footing/foundation encroachment into public areas PHP250 per square meter or fraction thereof.
